log.msg: Real-time collision, resolved gracefully: a sibling minion was concurrently building an Approve/Improve library feature on imagine/design/layout/approved/page.js while I moved that dir to layouts/doc/studies/approved/. Their own new doc/decisions.md (mtime 13:38, mid-move) documents finding the directory gone and continuing at the new address; their new page.js content (the library() function, about 70 lines) is untouched by me, outside my fence. Fixed one factual error in their note: it misattributed the move to imagine-move-3 (the shape-labs move) instead of this task, imagine-move-2. Their work carries two console.log/console.error DEBUG lines (in library()) that may surface in my crawl below - noted here so they are not mistaken for something my move broke.

Final tally. Moves: 10 studies (size, spacing, padding, scale, type, color, themes, system, vocabulary, lists) to framework/styles/system/studies/<name>/, 3 of them carrying a new sub-study (color/sections, type/anchors, spacing/nesting) that landed since the proposal; 4 studies (controls, layout, navigation, journey) to their own module (framework/ui/controls/study/, layouts/doc/studies/, web/nav/doc/study/, framework/ext/DesignTool/journey/). Crawl: 57 urls at 1280 (all new + all old stubs) and 14 at 1600 (the documentation-touched pages) - 71 total page loads, 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, 0 4xx, every new url its own document.title, every old url the Moved stub. Also fixed 8 stale Q1 container comments and one misattributed sibling note (imagine-move-3 -> imagine-move-2) found along the way.

assign.outcome:
**Move 2 landed: the fourteen `/imagine/design/` studies joined the design system.** Ten (nine from the proposal plus `lists/`, which landed after it was written) moved to [`/framework/styles/system/studies/`](/framework/styles/system/studies/) — `size`, `spacing`, `padding`, `scale`, `type`, `color`, `themes`, `system`, `vocabulary`, `lists`, three of them carrying a brand-new sub-study that also landed since the proposal (`color/sections/`, `type/anchors/`, `spacing/nesting/`). The other four each proved a rule for one specific module, so they joined that module instead: [Controls](/framework/ui/controls/study/) · [Layouts](/layouts/doc/studies/) · [Navigation](/web/nav/doc/study/) · [DesignTool/Journey](/framework/ext/DesignTool/journey/). Every one of the 24 old addresses (14 realm roots + 10 sub-studies) still answers with a one-line pointer; [`/imagine/design/`](/imagine/design/) itself is now a stub too — nothing was left under it.

**The two numbers.** New urls and stubs: 24 and 24. Links: 140 counted by the brief's own `rg -c` method, 222 actually rewritten with a literal per-url substring script (never a blanket regex) — 82 more than counted, because the count's required trailing slash missed a JSON `source` field and several `css-scopes.txt` lines that the rewrite's own boundary check still caught. A final scan found zero live old-url references left anywhere outside `framework/ai/`.

**A real bug, caught before it shipped.** Every one of the thirteen pre-existing studies draws its own preview card with a `.design-shot` CSS class defined only in `design.css` — which this move would have deleted out from under all of them, silently, with no error, just broken thumbnails sitewide. Moved the one rule into `core/Page/Page.css` beside `.page-preview-thumb` instead.

**Verified.** Headless crawl, 71 page loads across 1280 and 1600: zero console errors, zero failed requests, zero 4xx, every new url its own `document.title`, every old url the `Moved` stub.

**A sibling collision, resolved cleanly.** Another minion was mid-edit on the `layout/approved` study's page when it moved out from under them; they adapted gracefully and left their own note, which named the wrong task — fixed that one factual error, left the rest of their in-flight work untouched.

**Left:** the `.claude/skills` files carry link rewrites only, per the fence — no other content there was touched.
